꼬어웨이Niacin · Milk thistle · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)씨티씨바이오 · 2 times a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 50mg of Niacin, 130mg of Milk thistle, 45μg of Biotin, 25mg of Vitamin B1, 25mg of Vitamin B2, 25mg of Vitamin B6, 55μg of Selenium, 10mg of Zinc, 680μg of Folate, 25mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 capsule): 50mg Niacin, 130mg Milk thistle, 45μg Biotin, 25mg Vitamin B1, 25mg Vitamin B2, 25mg Vitamin B6, 55μg Selenium, 10mg Zinc, 680μg Folate, 25mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)씨티씨바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Milk thistle
    • May help with liver health
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (50mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Milk thistle labelled (130mg / 1000mg), 80~120%
Biotin labelled (45μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (25mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (25mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (25mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (55μg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (10mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (680μg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (25mg / 1000mg), 80~180%

Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하여 건조하고 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Milk thistle · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
